author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
This is my collection of posts that were supposed to go out as a Live Tweet Chat last night. I was accidently replying to my own post so nothing was syndicated to Twitter.

I will be spending today taking the screenshots and the video and parsing them down into something that is more useful than my stream on incoherent thoughts.

Okay huge PITA. I was trying to cut/paste between two posts on withknown and this happened. I will just start over today because that seems easier than trying to clean up this mess.

Sorry folks.

Here is the link to the YouTube Show: http://youtu.be/txpn4bLnOZw#QuestionTheWeb

Here is link to the curriculum: http://mozilla.github.io/webmaker-curriculum/WebLiteracyBasics-I/session02-hackthenews.html#Questiontheweb

Tip for Mozilla Web Club Curriculum, write an article at end of Kraken. Use article in Hacking the News. #Teachtheweb

So to switch a picture: change link in the between quotes: (I don't know how to display code without it rendering) But you will img followed by src="change the url here. You can copy and paste an image url by right clicking and choosing>copy image url"

I am now switching out the image by adding in a YouTube clip. #Questiontheweb: watch live: http://youtu.be/txpn4bLnOZw

Activate x-ray goggles and click on the any area where you see a color overlay:  #QuestionTheWeb 

Then switch the headline: http://goo.gl/1FzVk0 #Questiontheweb

For the picture just change the url in between -src="link to picture" for Youtube clip delete everything between:  including tags. #questiontheweb http://goo.gl/fP6v1b

Add a hyperlink back to Kraken story: http://goo.gl/IJVs8S#QuestionTheWeb

Just realized are all these cons emoticons, favicon, etc just fancy flat clip art? #Questiontheweb

Then you can change the text and style text: http://goo.gl/SudzAj #questiontheweb

Make sure to use openly licensed images: http://goo.gl/aZmkP8#QuestionTheWeb

Teach students to switch AND provide attribution to images: http://goo.gl/8zRt5L #QuestionTheWeb

Here is the finished version: http://jgmac1106.makes.org/goggles/jgmac1106s-remix-of-thedaycom-new-london-and-southeastern-connecticut-news-sports-business-entertainment-video-and-weather-the-day-newspaper-2 #QuestionTheWeb
